`stock_report.py` now marks an item `REORDER` when what's on hand is less than 6 days of average sales, and the 6 sits at the top as `LEAD_TIME_DAYS`. I ran it on your `inventory.csv`:

```
SKU      ITEM                       ON HAND  STATUS
CF-1K    House blend 1kg                  9  REORDER
CF-250   Colombia beans 250g             42  ok
FL-100   Paper filters x100               0  OUT
MG-12    Enamel mug                      18  ok
OT-1L    Oat milk 1L                     30  REORDER
TE-50    Breakfast tea x50               25  ok
```

House blend (9 on hand, about 14 needed) and oat milk (30 on hand, 45 needed) are the two that won't make it through a delivery wait. `OUT` still shows for anything at zero.

An item with exactly 6 days of stock left still shows `ok`, since it would run out just as the delivery lands. That leaves no cushion for a busy week or a late delivery; if you want one, bump `LEAD_TIME_DAYS` to 7 or 8.
